text.p: English premier league soccer club Arsenal denied on Wednesday they were planning to buy French international striker Ibrahim Ba from Bordeaux.
The French daily sports newspaper l'Equipe claimed the London club was ready to pay 35 million francs ($6.2 million).
L'Equipe added that Ba's father and his agent attended Arsenal's league game against Liverpool on Monday to discuss the move with Arsenal's French coach Arsene Wenger.
Bordeaux denied having any contact with Arsenal about the 24-year-old striker, who is under contract until 2001, and an Arsenal spokeswoman dismissed the report as "paper speculation."
"Mr Wenger admires many players and is always looking for the right players at the right price," she said.
